pages.title: Accumulate
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Sword, Axe, Trident$(br2)§lEffect: §r Hold right-click to charge, gaining one stage every 5 seconds (capped at the enchantment level). The next melee hit deals +50% damage per stage and knocks the target back. Switching the main-hand item, taking damage, or landing a hit clears the charge.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades
